verdict.rationale: Mastra docs explicitly describe real-time, incremental streaming of agent/workflow output, and note compatibility with Vercel AI SDK streaming formats (toAISdkStream), plus observability into tool calls and workflow steps. Missing for 10: explicit documentation/examples of streaming granular intermediate events (tool-call/step events) as distinct structured events rather than just token output, and independent hands-on confirmation of real-time UI integration.
